instance_info_cache_path.description: Path where to store the cache of instance polled information.

instance_info_cache_expiration.description: Time in minutes for the instance information cache expiration.

instance_info_cache_fuzzing.description: Time in minutes to randomly add to instance_info_cache_expiration to avoid polling all instances at the same time.

log_dir.description: Base directory used for relative log_file paths.
